ques: Open Players, filter for Dallas guards, then use the matching profile to report the player with at least 30 PPG and 9 APG, including his PPG, RPG, and APG.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: The run must open the Players list with both the Dallas team and guard-position filters, then open the qualifying player profile. The final answer must identify the player and report PPG, RPG, and APG. Empty answers, missing metrics, or answers without the required on-site navigation fail.

ques: Open Games from the top navigation and identify the two Game 6 cards shown on the NBA Games & Scores page, including each matchup and its listed broadcast partner.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: The run must open the Games page. The final answer must report both Game 6 matchups and bind each matchup to its displayed broadcast partner. Empty, partial, or unsupported answers fail.

ques: On the Games page, compare the Season Leaders panels for the two Game 6 cards and report which matchup contains the single highest PPG leader, with that player's name and PPG.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: The run must open the Games page and compare the Season Leaders shown for both Game 6 cards. The final answer must identify the relevant matchup, the highest-PPG leader, and that PPG value. Empty or incomplete comparisons fail.

ques: Use the Schedule page's 2026 Playoffs Schedule view to find the East Conference Finals row on Tuesday, May 19, then report the two teams, arena, city, and game number shown for that row.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: The run must open the Schedule page with the Playoffs season-type filter. The final answer must report the two teams, arena, city, and game number from the specified East Conference Finals row. Empty answers or missing fields fail.

ques: Use the 2023-24 Standings order to identify the Western Conference's top seed, then open that team profile and report its arena and head coach.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: The run must open the 2023-24 Standings page, use the displayed Western Conference seed order, and then open the top seed's team profile. The final answer must identify the team and report both its arena and head coach. Empty or partial answers fail.

ques: Go to Player Stats, sort or filter for Blocks, identify the leader and all players tied for second-highest, and report their names, BPG values, and the gap from first to second.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: The run must open Player Stats with Blocks selected. The final answer must report the blocks leader, every player tied for second-highest, their BPG values, and the gap between the first- and second-place values. Omitting a tied player, a value, or the gap fails.

ques: Go to Team Stats, switch to Point Diff, and report the top-ranked team plus its wins, losses, PPG, OPPG, and point differential.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: The run must open Team Stats with Point Diff selected. The final answer must identify the top-ranked team and bind it to wins, losses, PPG, OPPG, and point differential. Empty answers or missing metrics fail.

ques: Browse Teams by division, find the Pacific team whose profile lists Intuit Dome, and report that team's coach and record snapshot.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: The run must open Teams, identify the Pacific Division candidate, and open the matching team profile. The final answer must name the team and report the coach and record snapshot shown there. Empty or incomplete answers fail.

ques: From the Thunder team page, open the roster and then the frontcourt player's profile; report his position, height, weight, last attended, country, and blocks per game.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: The run must open the Thunder team page, its roster, and then the matching frontcourt player's profile. The final answer must identify the player and report position, height, weight, last attended, country, and blocks per game. Empty or partial answers fail.

ques: Open Draft, choose the AWS Draft Combine hero story, and report two evaluation themes or traits discussed in the article body after opening the detail page.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: The run must open Draft and then the AWS Draft Combine hero story detail page. The final answer must report two evaluation themes or traits stated in the article body, not merely repeat the card text. Empty, single-theme, or card-only answers fail.

ques: On the Draft page, use the Draft Process Key Dates section to report the dates for the 2026 NBA Draft first round and second round.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: The run must open the Draft page and use its Draft Process Key Dates section. The final answer must bind the first round and second round to their respective dates. Empty or partial answers fail.

ques: Open Fantasy and use the 2023-24 Player Stats table to compare Luka Doncic and Tyrese Haliburton; report which player has more assists per game and both AST values.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: The run must open Fantasy and inspect the 2023-24 Player Stats table. The final answer must compare the two named players, identify which has more assists per game, and report both AST values. Empty or incomplete comparisons fail.

ques: Open Stats, inspect the Players leader matrix and the right-rail More Stats list, then report the top player shown for Points and the top player shown for Total Assists.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: The run must open Stats and inspect both the Players leader matrix and the More Stats list. The final answer must bind the Points category and Total Assists category to their displayed leaders. Empty or partial answers fail.

ques: Starting from Search, look up spacing, open the Bucks half-court spacing article, and report the two offensive elements the article says Milwaukee is balancing.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: The run must submit the spacing query through the visible Search form and then open the Bucks half-court spacing article. The final answer must report both offensive elements from the article detail content. Empty answers, search-card-only answers, or missing article navigation fail.

ques: Open Watch, choose the card that is a Highlights story rather than a Video breakdown, and report its title plus the two teams involved.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: The run must open Watch and distinguish the Highlights card from Video breakdown cards. The final answer must report the selected story title and both teams involved. Empty or incomplete answers fail.

ques: Open Tickets without signing in, compare the listed scheduled games, and report the matchup, arena, and starting price for the highest-priced ticket card.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: The run must open Tickets while signed out and compare the listed scheduled-game cards. The final answer must bind the highest-priced card to its matchup, arena, and starting price. Empty, partial, or mismatched answers fail.

ques: Open Store, filter to T-Shirts, compare the available T-Shirt products, then open the cheapest product and report its name, team, color, price, and all listed product features.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: The run must open Store with the T-Shirts filter, compare the listed products, and open the cheapest product's detail page. The final answer must report its name, team, color, price, and every listed product feature. Empty, card-only, or partial-feature answers fail.

ques: Open Store, filter to Hoodies, find the Dallas item, then open its product page and report its price and all listed product features.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: The run must open Store with the Hoodies filter and then open the Dallas product detail page. The final answer must report the product, price, and every listed feature. Empty, listing-only, or partial-feature answers fail.

ques: Sign in with email alice.j@test.com and password TestPass123!, open Store, compare the two jersey products by price, add the higher-priced jersey to the bag in size XL with quantity 2, then continue to checkout and report the pre-order total without placing the order.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: The run must sign in with the provided benchmark account, compare the jersey products, open the higher-priced jersey, add exactly two in size XL, open the bag, and continue to checkout without placing an order. The final answer must report the displayed pre-order total. Empty answers, missing state changes, extra cart lines, or an order submission fail.

ques: Use Teams and 2023-24 Standings to identify the Southwest division team with a 50-32 record, then sign in with email alice.j@test.com and password TestPass123! and update the account profile so that team becomes the favorite team and the saved payment last four digits become 9090.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: The run must use Teams and 2023-24 Standings to identify the specified Southwest Division team, sign in with the provided benchmark account, open account editing, and save both the favorite-team and payment-last-four updates. The final answer must confirm both saved values. Empty answers, partial updates, unrelated user changes, or other database writes fail.
